translations.u240: The provisions of this article apply to transactions structured in accordance with the Sales Model of the Commission Sale. Within that Model, Fleequid performs the transaction by means of Resale pursuant to Art. 2.5 or may decide to act as a Pure Intermediary pursuant to Art. 2.6, with the Vehicle being transferred directly from the Seller to the Buyer. The possibility that the transaction may be performed by either method is made known before the Bid is placed, pursuant to Art. 3.2, letter a), and is accepted by adhering to these GTC. Fleequid may exercise the relevant choice even after the conclusion of the Binding Agreement and in any event no later than the making available of the Proforma, which crystallises the chosen method of performance pursuant to Art. 11.4; the Proforma is not the contractual source of the choice, but documents the exercise of a right previously made known and accepted. The choice between Resale and operation as a Pure Intermediary does not alter the Sales Model, does not bring to an end the mandate granted to Fleequid by the Seller and by the Buyer and does not affect Fleequid's right to the Commissions due from both. Fleequid's classification as a commission agent acting in its own name pursuant to Art. 1731 of the Italian Civil Code applies exclusively in the Resale pursuant to Art. 2.5; where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, the sale is concluded directly between the Seller and the Buyer pursuant to Arts. 2.6 and 17.10. Save where expressly referred to or in so far as compatible with the nature of the specific provision, the rules of this article do not apply to Dealer Sales, which are governed by Art. 18. Before the Proforma is made available, where the Seller commits one of the breaches provided for in letters c), d), e) and f) of Arts. 17.8 and 17.14 which is not covered, in respect of the same underlying fact and for the protection of the same interest, by a specific penalty provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, the Seller shall pay Fleequid, with reference to the marketing relationship referred to in Art. 8.8 and to the mandate granted to Fleequid and irrespective of the method of performance subsequently chosen, the residual penalty of 30% determined in accordance with the hierarchy of bases provided for in Art. 17.8, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage; as from the making available of the Proforma, Art. 17.8 or Art. 17.14 shall apply, depending on the chosen method of performance.
translations.u241: In the Commission Sale, both Parties owe Fleequid the Commissions determined in accordance with the Fleequid Fee Schedule or the further applicable conditions, in addition to the Fees for any Services rendered. The Commissions payable by the Seller accrue exclusively upon the successful completion of the transaction as provided for in Art. 12.4; those payable by the Buyer are due as provided for in the same paragraph and form part of the determination of the Total Amount Due.
translations.u243: Where Fleequid performs the Commission Sale by means of Resale, and provided that the conditions set out in Arts. 8.8 and 12.2 are met, Fleequid, acting in its own name and on behalf of the respective principals, formally purchases the Vehicle from the Seller and transfers it to the Buyer, thereby performing the commission mandates to sell and to purchase relating to the specific transaction. The purchase of the Vehicle by Fleequid in the context of the Resale is instrumental and functional to the subsequent transfer to the Buyer, who remains the substantial buyer in the transaction; Fleequid assumes the position of buyer and subsequent seller exclusively within the limits and for the purposes of the performance of the commission, without prejudice to the provisions of Arts. 19, 20 and 21 on warranty, liability and the linking of the contractual relationships. The conclusion of the Binding Agreement does not, in itself, entail the immediate performance of the Resale: the purchase of the Vehicle by Fleequid and the subsequent transfer to the Buyer take place exclusively following full performance of the Buyer's payment obligation pursuant to Art. 12.2, save as otherwise provided in the applicable Specific Terms and Conditions pursuant to Arts. 22.8 and 22.9. The performance of the Resale by means of the purchase of the Vehicle by Fleequid further remains conditional, until the time of purchase, upon the accuracy and completeness of the Technical Specifications and of the information contained in the Offer to Sell and in the Listing, as well as upon the correctness of the documents provided by the Seller or otherwise associated with the Vehicle, as provided for in Art. 8.8.
translations.u244: The price of the Vehicle due from Fleequid to the Seller in the Resale (the “Net Purchase Price”) corresponds to the Sale Price to the Buyer net of the Commissions payable by the Seller, the Fees and any other sum owed by the Seller to Fleequid pursuant to these General Terms and Conditions. The Seller expressly authorises Fleequid to set off and deduct the aforementioned amounts from the sums due to the Seller. The Net Purchase Price becomes due and payable exclusively after Fleequid has received the Total Amount Due in full from the Buyer pursuant to Art. 12.2; until that time the Seller shall have no enforceable claim against Fleequid, nor may it bring payment actions, issue payment demands or commence enforcement actions against Fleequid. The request for the issue of the invoice and any early issue thereof are of an administrative nature and do not render the consideration due and payable before the time indicated, nor do they constitute confirmation of fulfilment of the conditions laid down for the purchase of the Vehicle by Fleequid. The attainment of the Reserve Price, as determined on the basis of the MCSP set by the Seller, ensures the Seller net proceeds at least equal to the MCSP, save for the express acceptance of lower Bids pursuant to Art. 10.3. Where the sale is cancelled or its subject matter reduced pursuant to Art. 14, the Net Purchase Price due to the Seller is redetermined in accordance with the criteria provided for in Art. 14.5. The express derogation provided for in Art. 22.9 for transactions supported by a Financing Solution remains unaffected. The provisions of this paragraph do not apply where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary.
translations.u245: Where Fleequid proceeds by means of Resale, the Seller shall, at Fleequid's request, issue to Fleequid the invoice relating to the sale of the Vehicle within 5 (five) days from the request, in EUR and in accordance with the amounts, details and instructions communicated by Fleequid. The invoice shall state the Sale Price to the Buyer as well as the Commissions, the Fees and any reimbursement of expenses due to Fleequid, in addition to VAT where due by law; after setting off the amounts due pursuant to Art. 17.4, Fleequid shall settle the invoice in favour of the Seller once the Net Purchase Price has become due and payable pursuant to the same Art. 17.4. In the event of delay in issuing or transmitting the invoice beyond the aforementioned time limit, the Seller shall pay Fleequid a penalty of €150.00 (EUR one hundred and fifty/00) for each day of delay and for each Vehicle concerned, until performance, which penalty Fleequid shall be entitled to set off against the invoice amount, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage. Where, as a result of non-payment by the Buyer, the Cancellation of the Sale, the reduction of its subject matter, the correction of the transaction or any other cause provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, it becomes necessary to issue a credit note or a reversal or correction document, or to reissue the invoice, including as a consequence of a new sale of the Vehicle to a different Bidder for a different amount, the Seller shall do so within 5 (five) days from Fleequid's request; in the event of delay attributable to the Seller, the same daily penalty shall apply, which Fleequid shall be entitled to set off or deduct from subsequent sums due. The provisions of Arts. 15 and 16.2 relating to restitution, tax documentation and the further formalities necessary for the performance or reinstatement of the transaction remain unaffected.
translations.u246: The Buyer acknowledges and accepts that, in the Commission Sale performed by means of Resale, the purchase of the Vehicle by Fleequid is exclusively instrumental to its subsequent Resale to the Buyer and that the transaction is performed “subject to sale”, remaining conditional upon the actual availability of the Vehicle at the Seller's premises and its actual transfer from the Seller to Fleequid. The “subject to sale” clause does not affect the conclusion of the Binding Agreement or the obligations already incumbent on the Buyer, but governs the subsequent performance phase of the Resale. Where, owing to a circumstance attributable to the Seller, to the loss, destruction, non-conformity or supervening unavailability of the Vehicle or to any other circumstance preventing Fleequid from acquiring ownership thereof and performing the Resale, the transaction cannot be completed, Fleequid may proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale pursuant to Art. 14, without prejudice to the consequences provided for vis-à-vis the Seller. In such case the Buyer is entitled to the restitution of the sums that must be returned to it as provided for in Art. 15 but, save in the case of wilful misconduct or gross negligence on the part of Fleequid and save as mandatorily provided for by law, may not claim from Fleequid any further indemnity or compensation for the failure to perform, or the loss or unavailability of the Vehicle, attributable to the Seller. Fleequid's rights against the Seller, including penalties, indemnities, reimbursements, recourse and compensation for any further damage, remain unaffected.
translations.u247: Where Fleequid proceeds by means of Resale, Fleequid, in its capacity as purchaser of the Vehicle from the Seller, may notify the Seller of any non-conformities and apparent defects within 15 (fifteen) days from delivery of the Vehicle to the Buyer or, if later, within 15 (fifteen) days from receipt by Fleequid of the Buyer's complaint relating to the same non-conformity or the same defect. For hidden defects, Fleequid may give the notification within 1 (one) month from discovery or, if later, within 1 (one) month from receipt of the Buyer's complaint from which the defect emerges or in which it is notified. The Parties expressly agree that the aforementioned time limits take account of the structure of the Resale and of the fact that any defects or non-conformities may emerge only following delivery, use or the checks carried out by the Buyer. Payment of the Net Purchase Price to the Seller, any taking of delivery or temporary holding of the Vehicle by Fleequid, its movement, as well as the preparation of a TrustReport or the carrying out of inspections by Fleequid or by persons appointed by it do not constitute acceptance of the Vehicle as free from defects or as conforming to the Seller's representations and do not entail any waiver of the rights and remedies available to Fleequid. The Seller's liability and obligations of indemnity, reimbursement and recourse provided for in Arts. 8.13 and 19.6 remain unaffected; in addition to compensation for damage, the Seller shall reimburse Fleequid for the sums, costs, repair expenses and any other charge that Fleequid has incurred vis-à-vis its own Buyer for circumstances attributable to the Seller, with an express right of recourse.
translations.u248: Fleequid is entitled to terminate, in whole or in part, pursuant to Art. 1456 of the Italian Civil Code, the contractual relationship relating to the purchase of the Vehicle from the Seller, by written notice declaring its intention to rely on this express termination clause, and to proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale pursuant to Art. 14, where the Seller: a) has created or allowed the creation of Encumbrances on the Vehicle in addition to those declared, or has failed to remove them within the time limits provided for in Art. 8.3; b) is unable to ensure the unencumbered transfer of the Vehicle because the net proceeds due to it prove insufficient to satisfy the creditors entitled to the release of the asset and the further amounts due in relation to the transaction, or because the beneficiaries of the Encumbrances refuse the release or the unencumbered sale; c) has provided, during the registration process, in submitting the Offer to Sell or thereafter, false, inaccurate, fraudulent, outdated or incomplete information or documents relevant to the specific transaction; d) breaches the obligations provided for in these General Terms and Conditions concerning ownership, availability, custody and preservation of the Vehicle, truthfulness of information, documentation, exclusivity, transfer of ownership, delivery, environmental legislation or third-party rights; e) breaches mandatory rules or administrative provisions applicable to the marketing, transfer or management of the Vehicle, or third-party rights, in such a way as to prejudice the continuation of the transaction or render it risky; f) refuses or fails to transfer ownership of the Vehicle or to carry out the acts or formalities or provide the cooperation necessary for the registration of the Vehicle in, or its transfer into, the name of Fleequid, or is in breach of the obligation to make it available or deliver it as provided for in these General Terms and Conditions. Fleequid further retains the right to suspend the transaction or the marketing of the Vehicle and to adopt the measures reasonably necessary where this is appropriate to prevent fraud, protect the security of the Marketplace, of Fleequid, of the Buyer or of third parties, verify situations of risk, carry out investigations or ensure compliance with the applicable legislation, including environmental legislation; the adoption of such measures is precautionary in nature and does not in itself entail the exercise of the express termination clause or the application of the penalty provided for in this paragraph, which presuppose that a breach of contract or of law attributable to the Seller has been established. In the event of termination or Cancellation on one of the grounds provided for in this paragraph, the Commissions payable by the Seller which may have already accrued pursuant to Art. 12.4, the Fees, the costs and expenses incurred by Fleequid in relation to the transaction and the further amounts accrued on a separate legal basis remain due. In the cases referred to in letters c), d), e) and f), unless the same underlying fact is already covered, for the protection of the same interest, by a specific penalty provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, including, by way of example, those referred to in Arts. 8.9, 8.11, 8.12 and 16.9, the Seller shall also pay Fleequid, by way of penalty, an amount equal to 30% of the Reserve Price determined for the first Auction relating to the Vehicle, any subsequent reductions of the Reserve Price being irrelevant, or, where no Auction with a Reserve Price has been held for the Vehicle but a Reserve Price has been set for the specific transaction, to 30% of such Reserve Price, or again, where no Reserve Price has been set for the specific transaction, to 30% of the Sale Price to the Buyer or, failing also the Sale Price to the Buyer, to 30% of the MCSP relating to the specific transaction, save as provided for in Art. 18.5 for Dealer Sales, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage. In cases where, pursuant to the preceding sentence and Art. 15.8, a specific penalty applies in place of that provided for in this paragraph, the right of termination pursuant to Art. 1456 of the Italian Civil Code and the further consequences provided for in this paragraph other than the penalty remain unaffected; the consequences provided for distinct facts or breaches may, by contrast, be cumulated, as provided for in Art. 15.8. With reference to the refusal or failure to transfer ownership of the Vehicle referred to in letter f), the penalty provided for in this paragraph does not apply in respect of the same fact even before the conditions constituting the refusal provided for in Art. 8.11 are met; once such conditions are met, the specific penalty provided for in Art. 8.11, letter a), applies, the right of termination pursuant to Art. 1456 of the Italian Civil Code and the further consequences provided for in this paragraph other than the penalty remaining unaffected.
translations.u249: The linking clause referred to in Art. 21, to which reference is made in full, applies to the Commission Sale performed by means of Resale.
translations.u251: Where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary pursuant to Art. 2.6, the sale is concluded directly between the Seller and the Buyer and the Vehicle is transferred directly from the Seller to the Buyer, without Fleequid concluding the sale, either in its own name or as a party, without Fleequid acquiring ownership of the Vehicle, even temporarily, and without Fleequid assuming the capacity of seller, even as formal seller. The price of the Vehicle is owed by the Buyer directly to the Seller and does not pass through Fleequid's accounts, without prejudice to the Commissions, the Fees and the further amounts due to Fleequid. The Seller and the Buyer shall carry out directly, with any cooperation and coordination provided by Fleequid, all the formalities necessary for the transfer of ownership, invoicing, documentation, delivery and collection of the Vehicle as provided for in Arts. 11, 12 and 16. Any assistance, coordination or administrative management activity carried out by Fleequid does not entail the assumption by Fleequid of the capacity of buyer or seller of the Vehicle, or of debtor or creditor of the relevant price, Fleequid remaining party to the separate mandate relationships with the Seller and with the Buyer and retaining the right to the Commissions and to the further amounts due to it.
translations.u252: Where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, the Seller shall issue and transmit to the Buyer the sales invoice for the Vehicle within 5 (five) days from receipt of the details necessary for its issue pursuant to Art. 11.4; the invoice must correspond to the price due directly to the Seller, plus VAT where applicable. In the event of delay in issuing or transmitting the invoice, the Seller shall pay Fleequid a penalty of €150.00 (EUR one hundred and fifty/00) for each day of delay and for each Vehicle concerned, until performance, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage. Where it becomes necessary to issue a credit note or a reversal or correction document, or to reissue the invoice, the Seller shall do so within 5 (five) days from Fleequid's request, the same penalty applying in the event of delay. Any delay by the Seller in issuing or transmitting the invoice neither suspends nor defers the Buyer's Payment Period, provided that the Proforma contains all the elements necessary to enable payment to be made. The tax documents relating to the Commissions, the Fees and the further amounts due to Fleequid are issued by Fleequid as provided for in Art. 16.2.
translations.u253: Where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, the transfer of ownership of the Vehicle from the Seller to the Buyer remains deferred by agreement until full performance of the payment obligation pursuant to Art. 12.2 and completion of the necessary formalities, as provided for in Art. 16.4, to which reference is also made for the ordinary time limit of 10 (ten) days for completion of the transfer formalities and for the possibility of a different time limit provided for in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions. The provisions of Art. 16 apply to delivery, collection, failure to collect, the passing of risk, the inspection of the Vehicle and transport.
translations.u254: Where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, neither Art. 17.4 nor Art. 17.8 applies, Art. 17.14 applying in place of the latter; likewise, the authorisation referred to in Art. 1395 of the Italian Civil Code, the reference to Art. 1515(3) of the Italian Civil Code contained in Art. 2.5, and the linking clause referred to in Art. 21, which applies exclusively to the Resale, do not apply. The warranty regime vis-à-vis the Buyer is governed by Art. 19 and, in particular, by Art. 19.7, letter b); the complaint procedure is governed by Art. 20; the restitutionary and financial effects are governed by Art. 15.
translations.u255: Where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, Fleequid is entitled to terminate, pursuant to Art. 1456 of the Italian Civil Code, the mandate relationship with the Seller relating to the specific transaction referred to in Art. 17.10, by written notice declaring its intention to rely on this express termination clause, and to proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale pursuant to Art. 14, where the Seller: a) has created or allowed the creation of Encumbrances on the Vehicle in addition to those declared, or has failed to remove them within the time limits provided for in Art. 8.3; b) is unable to ensure the unencumbered transfer of the Vehicle to the Buyer because the sums due to it prove insufficient to satisfy the creditors entitled to the release of the asset, or because the beneficiaries of the Encumbrances refuse the release or the unencumbered sale; c) has provided, during the registration process, in submitting the Offer to Sell or thereafter, false, inaccurate, fraudulent, outdated or incomplete information or documents relevant to the specific transaction; d) breaches the obligations provided for in these General Terms and Conditions concerning ownership, availability, custody and preservation of the Vehicle, truthfulness of information, documentation, exclusivity, transfer of ownership, delivery, environmental legislation or third-party rights; e) breaches mandatory rules or administrative provisions applicable to the marketing, transfer or management of the Vehicle, or third-party rights, in such a way as to prejudice the continuation of the transaction or render it risky; f) refuses or fails to transfer ownership of the Vehicle directly to the Buyer or to carry out the acts or formalities or provide the cooperation necessary for the registration of the Vehicle in, or its transfer into, the name of the Buyer, or is in breach of the obligation to make it available or deliver it as provided for in these General Terms and Conditions. The exercise of the aforementioned rights concerns exclusively the relationship between Fleequid and the Seller and the transaction managed by Fleequid and does not entail the assumption by Fleequid of the capacity of party to the sale concluded directly between the Seller and the Buyer, the rights and remedies available to the Buyer against the Seller and the restitutionary effects provided for in Art. 15 remaining unaffected. Fleequid further retains the right to suspend the transaction or the marketing of the Vehicle and to adopt the measures reasonably necessary where this is appropriate to prevent fraud, protect the security of the Marketplace, of Fleequid, of the Buyer or of third parties, verify situations of risk, carry out investigations or ensure compliance with the applicable legislation, including environmental legislation; the adoption of such measures is precautionary in nature and does not in itself entail the exercise of the express termination clause or the application of the penalty provided for in this paragraph, which presuppose that a breach of contract or of law attributable to the Seller has been established. In the event of termination or Cancellation on one of the grounds provided for in this paragraph, the Commissions payable by the Seller which may have already accrued pursuant to Art. 12.4, the Fees, the costs and expenses incurred by Fleequid in relation to the transaction and the further amounts accrued on a separate legal basis remain due. In the cases referred to in letters c), d), e) and f), unless the same underlying fact is already covered, for the protection of the same interest, by a specific penalty provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, including, by way of example, those referred to in Arts. 8.9, 8.11, 8.12 and 16.9, the Seller shall also pay Fleequid, by way of penalty, an amount equal to 30% of the Reserve Price determined for the first Auction relating to the Vehicle, any subsequent reductions of the Reserve Price being irrelevant, or, where no Auction with a Reserve Price has been held for the Vehicle but a Reserve Price has been set for the specific transaction, to 30% of such Reserve Price, or again, where no Reserve Price has been set for the specific transaction, to 30% of the Sale Price to the Buyer or, failing also the Sale Price to the Buyer, to 30% of the MCSP relating to the specific transaction, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage. In particular, for the refusal to transfer ownership of the Vehicle directly to the Buyer, the penalty provided for in Art. 8.11, letter c), continues to apply. In cases where, pursuant to the preceding sentences and Art. 15.8, a specific penalty applies in place of that provided for in this paragraph, the right of termination pursuant to Art. 1456 of the Italian Civil Code, the right of Cancellation and the further consequences provided for in this paragraph other than the penalty remain unaffected; the consequences provided for distinct facts or breaches may, by contrast, be cumulated, as provided for in Art. 15.8. With reference to the refusal or failure to transfer ownership of the Vehicle referred to in letter f), the penalty provided for in this paragraph does not apply in respect of the same fact even before the conditions constituting the refusal provided for in Art. 8.11 are met; once such conditions are met, the specific penalty provided for in Art. 8.11, letter c), applies, the right of termination pursuant to Art. 1456 of the Italian Civil Code, the right of Cancellation and the further consequences provided for in this paragraph other than the penalty remaining unaffected.
translations.u257: In Dealer Sales Fleequid purchases the Vehicle from the Seller in its own name and on its own behalf and resells it to the Buyer in its own name and on its own behalf, assuming the capacity of substantial party to both sales, respectively as buyer in the relationship with the Seller and as seller in the relationship with the Buyer. The two sale relationships are separate and independent and each is governed by its own financial terms. In Dealer Sales Fleequid does not act as mandatary or commission agent of the Seller or of the Buyer and the provisions of these General Terms and Conditions that presuppose the Commission Sale do not apply, save where expressly referred to. In Dealer Sales the Commissions specific to the Commission Sale are not due, without prejudice to the Fees and any further amounts due on a separate legal basis; any difference between the Purchase Price and the Sale Price to the Buyer constitutes the financial result of the purchase and sale activity carried out by Fleequid and not a Commission, nor a parameter for determining the Commissions or the penalties calculated by reference to them.
translations.u258: In Dealer Sales the purchase of the Vehicle by Fleequid may take place following the identification of a specific Buyer, including as the outcome of an Auction or of another Sales Event organised via the Marketplace (“back-to-back purchase”). In such case the purchase relationship between the Seller and Fleequid is subject to the rules provided for in Art. 8.8, including the condition precedent relating to the performance of the purchase, agreed in the exclusive interest of Fleequid. Fleequid is nevertheless entitled, at its discretion, to purchase the Vehicle before the identification of a specific Buyer and to market or resell it subsequently, including by means of one or more Sales Events (“purchase for stock”). In such case the purchase of the Vehicle by Fleequid is independent of the subsequent sale to the Buyer, does not depend on the existence of a Binding Agreement and is not subject to the condition provided for in Art. 8.8, unless otherwise agreed between Fleequid and the Seller. The purchase for stock may also take place where it is agreed that the Vehicle shall temporarily remain in use by, or otherwise at the disposal of, the Seller; in such case the fact that the Vehicle physically remains with the Seller does not, in itself, affect the fact that the purchase by Fleequid has taken place or the effects already produced by the relevant contract, without prejudice to the provisions of these General Terms and Conditions and of any conditions applicable to the specific transaction concerning custody, use, delivery and transfer of risk. The rules provided for in Art. 13 for transactions in which, after the conclusion of the Binding Agreement with the Buyer, the Vehicle temporarily remains in use by the Seller likewise remain unaffected, where the relevant conditions are met.
translations.u259: The Purchase Price due from Fleequid to the Seller is independently agreed between Fleequid and the Seller and may not be lower than the MCSP indicated in the Offer to Sell, where the MCSP is applicable to the case in question, unless the Seller expressly accepts a different, lower amount. Before the start of the Sales Event, the Purchase Price or the financial criterion, already accepted by the Seller, enabling it to be determined must have been established and made known to the Seller pursuant to Art. 3.7, letter b). In the purchase for stock such elements are determined within the purchase relationship between Fleequid and the Seller. The Sale Price to the Buyer is independent of the Purchase Price and is determined in accordance with the rules applicable to the specific Sales Event; there is no necessary link between the two prices.
translations.u260: In Dealer Sales the Seller shall, at Fleequid's request, issue to Fleequid the invoice relating to the sale of the Vehicle within 5 (five) days from the request, in accordance with the details and instructions communicated by Fleequid. The invoice is issued with reference to the Purchase Price agreed pursuant to Art. 18.3, plus VAT where applicable and any further amounts relating exclusively to the relevant sale relationship. In the event of delay in issuing or transmitting the invoice, the Seller shall pay Fleequid a penalty of €150.00 (EUR one hundred and fifty/00) for each day of delay and for each Vehicle concerned, until performance, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage. Where it becomes necessary to issue a credit note or a reversal or correction document, or to reissue the invoice, the Seller shall do so within 5 (five) days from Fleequid's request, the same penalty applying in the event of delay. The invoicing by Fleequid to the Buyer, governed by Art. 16.2, remains separate and independent.
translations.u261: In the purchase relationship between the Seller and Fleequid, the representations, warranties and obligations of indemnity, reimbursement and recourse imposed on the Seller by these General Terms and Conditions, including those provided for in Arts. 8.3, 8.12, 8.13 and 19.6, remain fully unaffected, as do the rules on notification and the related time limits referred to in Art. 17.7 and the express termination clause and the financial consequences referred to in Art. 17.8, which apply to the purchase contract concluded by Fleequid in Dealer Sales; for the purposes of determining the penalty provided for in Art. 17.8, where neither a Reserve Price nor a Sale Price to the Buyer exists for the Vehicle, as may occur in particular in the purchase for stock, the final subsidiary basis is, in place of the MCSP, the Purchase Price due from Fleequid to the Seller. The purchase of the Vehicle by Fleequid neither extinguishes nor reduces such protections. The indemnity referred to in Art. 8.13 expressly operates also with reference to claims brought by the Buyer against Fleequid as substantial seller, as well as to the sums, costs, repairs, expenses, charges and damages that Fleequid incurs in that capacity for acts, defects, faults, omissions or breaches attributable to the Seller, with a right of recourse and of full reimbursement against the Seller. Where a non-conformity, a defect, damage to the Vehicle or other circumstance attributable to the Seller emerges, or is notified by the Buyer, after the resale of the Vehicle, Fleequid retains the right to assert it against the Seller within the time limits provided for in Art. 17.7, running, where the fact was not already previously known to Fleequid, from its discovery or from receipt of the Buyer's complaint. Payment of the Purchase Price, the taking of delivery of the Vehicle by Fleequid or by persons appointed by it and the subsequent resale to the Buyer do not entail any waiver of the rights of indemnity, recourse or reimbursement or of the further remedies available to Fleequid against the Seller.
translations.u262: The transfer of ownership and the passing of risk from the Seller to Fleequid take place as agreed in the relevant purchase relationship and, failing that, at the time of delivery of the Vehicle to Fleequid or to the person appointed by it. The transfer of ownership of the Vehicle from Fleequid to the Buyer and the passing of the related risk are governed by Art. 16 and, in particular, by Arts. 16.4 and 16.5, to which reference is made, including in cases where Fleequid has acquired ownership of the Vehicle prior to full performance of the Buyer's payment obligation, in the context of a purchase for stock or as a result of the waiver of the condition provided for in Art. 8.8 in the back-to-back purchase. The provisions of Arts. 13.9 and 18.7 remain unaffected where the Vehicle temporarily remains in use by, or otherwise at the disposal of, the Seller. Any different provisions of the Specific Terms and Conditions applicable to the individual transaction remain unaffected, including where a Financing Solution is involved.
translations.u263: In the purchase for stock Fleequid markets and resells the Vehicle as owner and substantial seller vis-à-vis the Buyer and this circumstance is made known as provided for in Art. 3.2. As from the completion of the purchase of the Vehicle by Fleequid, the provisions of Arts. 8.8, 8.9, 8.10 and 8.11 cease to apply pro futuro in the relationship with the Seller: where the purchase for stock is preceded by a phase of marketing of the Vehicle through Fleequid, such provisions operate until the completion of the purchase; where the purchase for stock is direct and not preceded by any marketing phase, they are inapplicable from the outset. In any event, the rights and penalties already accrued before the completion of the purchase remain unaffected, as do the Seller's obligations intended to survive the purchase, including those relating to warranties, representations, indemnities, liability, delivery of documentation, tax matters, reimbursement, recourse and compensation, as provided for in Art. 18.5. Where, before the opening of the Sales Event, Fleequid has already acquired physical possession of the Vehicle and the Seller's obligations necessary for its delivery and subsequent resale have been performed, the “subject to sale” clause referred to in Art. 17.6 does not apply, Fleequid being liable for delivery of the Vehicle as seller. Where, by contrast, the Vehicle, although already purchased by Fleequid, temporarily remains in use by, or otherwise at the disposal of, the Seller, or has yet to be made available or delivered by the Seller, the rules provided for in Art. 17.6 apply, in so far as compatible; in such case the conclusion of the Binding Agreement with the Buyer is not conditional upon the completion or effectiveness of the purchase of the Vehicle by Fleequid, which have already occurred, but the subsequent performance of the sale remains conditional upon the actual availability of the Vehicle and its delivery by the Seller in the agreed condition. Where, owing to breach by the Seller, loss, destruction, non-conformity such as to prevent performance of the sale in the agreed condition, supervening unavailability of the Vehicle or any other circumstance attributable to the relationship with the Seller, Fleequid is unable to perform the sale to the Buyer, Fleequid may proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale as provided for in Arts. 14 and 15; in such case, save in the case of wilful misconduct or gross negligence on the part of Fleequid and save as mandatorily provided for by law, the Buyer is entitled to the restitution of the sums that must be returned to it pursuant to Art. 15, with no right to further indemnity or compensation from Fleequid for circumstances attributable to the Seller. In any event, in the relationship between Fleequid and the Seller, all obligations arising from the purchase relationship not yet performed remain unaffected, as do the warranties, the penalties, the obligations of indemnity, reimbursement and recourse and the further remedies provided for in these General Terms and Conditions.
